programme.title: Charles Mingus, Jaki Byard, Dannie Richmond & Johnny Coles
programme.sub-title: Charles Mingus And Eric Dolphy live in Liège
programme.desc: Charles Mingus showcases an exceptional concert performed in April 1965 featuring his most celebrated lineup: Jaki Byard (piano), Dannie Richmond (drums), Johnny Coles (trumpet), Clifford Jordan (tenor sax) and the great Eric Dolphy (alto sax, flute and bass clarinet). Recorded within an eight-day span, less than three months before Dolphy's death, the three concerts showcase Mingus's visionary leadership and the band's incredible depth and diversity with unique performances and arrangements of classics including ‘So Long Eric' and the groundbreaking ‘Meditations On Integration'.

programme.title: Lianne La Havas
programme.desc: Lianne La Havas' performance at Casino de Paris captures the British singer-songwriter at her best: with her crystalline voice she performs soulful melodies full of sincerity. The performance is part of La Havas' 'Blood Tour', a concert tour promoting her second album 'Blood' (2015). She is accompanied by James Wyatt on keys, Adam Prendergast on bass, Giles King Ashong on drums, and Frida Touray on backing vocals.

programme.title: Maceo Parker
programme.desc: As a 25-year-old saxophonist, Maceo Parker played in the band of James Brown, but he is also known for his collaborations with George Clinton's Parliament-Funkadelic and Bootsy Collins' Rubber Band. Maceo has proven his star quality by creating a special chemistry between all the different styles of American black music. As a pioneer in the ‘groove', he blends funky jazz with roots and blues with gospel. The result? Overheated concert halls, with enthusiastic audiences that completely surrender themselves to the music's boundless energy.

programme.title: Chet Baker
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Buster Williams
programme.sub-title: Ode to Miles: Bitches Brew Beyond
programme.desc: For the 40th anniversary of jazz legend Miles Davis' legendary album Bitches Brew, trumpeter Wallace Roney leads a band that revives the master's music. This project is the brainchild of Miles' family (including his son Erin), which is represented by his nephew, drummer Vince Wilburn. This concert at the ancient theater in Vienne, France, is a grand tribute to Miles.

programme.title: Bill Evans
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Sun Ra
programme.sub-title: Sun Ra Arkestra - Estival Jazz Lugano
programme.desc: Estival Jazz Lugano is an annual open-air music festival that takes place over five days at the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. On July 3, 1985, pianist and space-faring jazz icon Sun Ra and his Arkestra crash-landed at Estival Jazz Lugano. Featuring saxophonists Marshall Allen, John Gilmore and Danny Ray Thompson, clarinetist Eloe Omoe, flautist James Jackson, trombonist Tyrone Hill and a cavalcade of other costumed talents, Sun Ra puts on a truly out-of-this-world concert.

programme.title: Walter Trout, Johnny Griparic, Teddy Andreadis "Zig Zag" & Michael Leasure
programme.desc: Every year since 1970, the German city of Burghausen has been hosting one of the largest jazz festivals in the world. During Burghausen International Jazz Week, Burghausen becomes a 'Bavarian jazz mecca': guests from all over the world join the Burghausers to enjoy the most wonderful jazz performances as the colorful hustle and bustle of spectators and musicians shake up the city. One of the bands performing here in 2019 is the Walter Trout Band. Trout, who was born in New Jersey and is based in Los Angeles, is a world-famous contemporary blues rock guitarist and vocalist.

programme.title: Avishai Cohen
programme.desc: Double bassist Avishai Cohen's trio with Noam David (drums) and Omri Mor (pianist) joined forces with the international Symphony Orchestra ‘INSO-Lviv', conducted by Christian Schumann. On June 24, 2017 they brought Avishai Cohen's signature blend of influences from Eastern Europe, American jazz and the Middle East to the Alfa Jazz Festival in Lviv, Ukraine. Cohen, who also supplies vocalizations in the Judeo-Spanish dialect Ladino, came to prominence internationally in the 1990s when jazz great Chick Corea offered him a place in his trio and a recording deal. Thirty years later, Cohen has become a house-hold name himself, leaving his Ukrainian audience enthralled and connected through the universal language of music.

programme.title: Marcus Miller
programme.desc: This portrait of Marcus Miller was recorded during his 2009 ‘Tutu Revisited' tour. Miller looks back on his relationship with Miles Davis. Miller tells us about writing his composition 'Tutu', and shares countless stories of the recording process of the album 'Tutu'. This documentary was filmed in 2009 at the 'We Want Miles' exhibition in Cité de la Musique in Paris.

programme.title: Marta Gardolińska, Gareth Davies & London Symphony Orchestra
programme.sub-title: The LSO performs Boulanger, Dalbavie & Tchaikovsky
programme.desc: Polish conductor Marta Gardolińska conducts the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in a concert program consisting of Lili Boulanger's D'un Martin de Printemps, Marc-André Dalbavie's Concerto for Flute, and Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's Symphony No. 4 in F minor, Op. 36. The luminous optimism of the young Boulanger is poles apart from the raw passion and white-hot melodies of Tchaikovsky's semi-autobiographical symphony. LSO principal flute Gareth Davies brings out all the dazzle and daring of Dalbavie's 21st-century classic. The program closes with Prayer for Ukraine by composer Valentin Silvestrov. This concert was recorded at LSO St Luke's in London, UK, on May 18, 2022.

programme.title: Les Dissonances & David Grimal
programme.sub-title: Brahms - Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 73
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances present Johannes Brahms's Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 73. Whereas it took the composer over a decade to complete his first symphony, he penned his Symphony No. 2 in just a few months, during his summer sojourn in the restful Austrian village of Pörtschach in 1877. Nicknamed his ‘Pastoral' symphony, the work is arguably the most sunny and optimistic of Brahms's four symphonies. Lyrical in character, it features joyful melodies. This performance was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris, France, in 2015.

programme.title: Martha Argerich
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Martha Argerich, Iddo Bar-Shai, Maxim Vengerov & Mischa Maisky
programme.desc: In May and June 2021, Argentinian star pianist Martha Argerich celebrated her 80th birthday performing at Château de Chantilly, France. In this concert, recorded at the festival Les Coups de Cœur de Chantilly, Argerich is joined by three musicians who are particularly close to her heart: cellist Mischa Maisky, violinist Maxim Vengerov, and pianist Iddo Bar-Shaï. They perform with the orchestra Les Siècles under the baton of Romanian-Austrian conductor Ion Marin. The concert opens with Ludwig van Beethoven's Triple Concerto in C major, Op. 56, with Argerich, Vengerov, and Maisky as soloists. Written in 1803, it is Beethoven's only concerto for more than one solo instrument. This is followed by Camille Saint-Saëns's musical suite The Carnival of the Animals (Le carnaval des animaux), featuring Argerich and Bar-Shaï as the pianists. This musical suite from 1886 consists of 14 movements, each depicting a different animal. The work was published posthumously in 1922, as Saint-Saëns was concerned that his animal miniatures, full of delightful jokes, might damage his reputation as a serious composer. This performance was recorded at Château de Chantilly, on May 4, 2021.

programme.title: Leonardo García Alarcón, Cappella Mediterranea & Mariana Flores
programme.sub-title: Vocal baroque works by Cavalli, Strozzi & Bembo
programme.desc: Argentinian conductor and harpsichordist Leonardo García Alarcón leads his ensemble Cappella Mediterranea in a program of Italian Baroque music. The ensemble performs some of the finest Baroque pieces composed by Francesco Cavalli, a prominent composer in 17th-century Venice, and two of his famous students, Barbara Strozzi and Antonia Bembo. Argentinian soprano Mariana Flores presents the vocal works. On the program are ‘Mira questi due lumi' from Cavalli's Le nozze di Teti e di Peleo, ‘Dimmi, Amor, che farò' from L'Oristeo, ‘Sinfonia della notte' from L'Egisto, and ‘E vuol dunque Ciprigna' from Ercole Amante ‘M'ingannasti in verità' from Bembo's Produzioni armoniche consacrate a Luigi XIV Strozzi's Sino alla morte, Che si può fare, Lagrime mie, L'amante segreto, and è Pazzo il moi core Biagio Marini's La Romanesca Tarquinio Merula's Aria Sopra La Cieccona and Dario Castello's Sonata Seconda. This performance was recorded at the magnificent Église Notre-Dame of Sablé-sur-Sarthe, France, on August 26, 2020.

programme.title: Valery Gergiev
programme.desc: This visually stunning production of Nutcracker is a graceful and timeless adventure on a grand scale. From the lovely Waltz of the Flowers to the crystalline beauty of the stunning Snowflake Waltz, each scene is more breathtaking than the last, bringing to life all the well-known and beloved characters with fresh sparkle and compelling originality. It is Christmas Eve and we are brought to a party at which Drosselmeyer gives young Clara a nutcracker doll - beginning a night that includes a magically growing Christmas tree, a midnight battle of toy soldiers at which the Nutcracker defeats the villainous Mouse King and his army of mice, and a headlong pas de deux in which Clara and Hans-Peter meet and celebrate their triumph before being enveloped in a magical snowstorm. Act II whisks the young pair off to the Kingdom of the Sweets, where they are entertained by the Sugar Plum Fairy with her handsome Prince and her glittering court in a series of dazzling dances. Under the direction of Andreas Morell, Valery Gergiev conducts the Mariinsky Orchestra and Choir. Soloists are Mikhail Makarov, lldar Abdrazakov, Anna Markarova, Sergei Skorokhodov, Timur Abdikeyev, Vladislav Sulimasky. This production was recorded at the Mariinsky Theatre in 2012.

programme.title: Guess Who

To prove his bravery, he sets sail with Mikey, a well-behaved boy whose life Sharky has turned upside down, and Bonnie, a trouble-shooting girl who tends to assume command in every situation. This motley crew sails for big adventures as they thwart the plans of The Admiral and Old Bill the Pirate.

programme.title: The Great Ghost Rescue
programme.desc: Young Humphrey is a ghost with a big problem. He and his family, the Craggyfords, have been ousted from their home and left without a place to haunt. As they search for new haunting grounds they soon discover that they are not alone.

programme.title: An Elephant's Journey
programme.desc: An Elephant's Journey' is a fun-filled and moving family adventure about a circus elephant and the importance of family and friendship. Starring Disney Channel favourite Jenna Ortega and Hollywood's David Arquette and Tom Arnold, fans of 'Dumbo' will love this film. Flora is a circus elephant who can no longer perform her tricks. Left out and alone, the circus owner's 14-year old daughter, Dawn, sneaks Flora from the circus after she finds the perfect place for retirement: an elephant sanctuary 480 km away. All that stands between them and the safety of the elephant preserve is hundreds of kilometres of woods, one raging river, two elephant hunters and the fear of not making it.

programme.title: The 39 Steps

programme.title: Bang Bang You're Dead

programme.title: The Way Back (2011)

programme.title: Runaway Jury

programme.title: Sky Kids
programme.desc: As a pair of schoolboys sneak a look around an empty private aircraft, two criminals take off with the kids still inside. Upon discovering the men are dangerous gangsters, the horrified lads inadvertently become embroiled in the mobsters's scheme.

programme.title: Big Mommas House
programme.desc: In order to protect a woman from a robber, a male FBI agent disguises himself as an elderly woman.

programme.title: Pandorum
programme.desc: Two astronauts (Dennis Quaid, Vantage Point and Ben Foster, 30 Days of Night) awaken in a hyper-sleep chamber aboard a seemingly abandoned spacecraft. It's pitch black, they are disoriented, and the only sound is a low rumble and creak from the belly of the ship. They can't remember anything like who they are and what their mission is, but one thing they do realise very quickly is that they are not alone. Slowly the spacecraft's shocking, deadly secrets are revealed and the astronauts find that they must fight to stay alive and that their survival is more important than they could ever have imagined. Directed by Christian Alvart and also starring Cam Gigandet (Twilight), Cung Le (Tekken) and newcomer Antje Traue.

programme.title: A Single Man
programme.desc: An adaptation based on a novel by Christopher Isherwood, A Single Man is a romantic tale of love interrupted, the isolation that is an inherent part of the human condition, and ultimately the importance of the seemingly smaller moments in life. Set in Los Angeles in 1962, at the height of the Cuban missile crisis, A Single Man, tells the story of a British college professor (Colin Firth) who dwells on the past and cannot see his future. We follow him through a single day, where a series of events and encounters, ultimately leads him to decide if there is a meaning to life after the death of his long time partner, Jim (Matthew Goode, Watchmen).

programme.title: Survivor
programme.desc: Alone, stranded and deadly. This thrilling Sci-Fi sees Kate Mitra, a beautiful young astronaut who detects a faint radio transmission from a planet within a nearby wormhole. Is this first contact with a friendly alien race? Or a harbinger of unimaginable terror? She quickly discovers that the terrifying inhabitants of the planet will stop at nothing to prevent them from leaving.

programme.title: Robot Overlords
programme.desc: Welcome to the ultimate battle between robots and mankind! When teenager Sean (Callan McAuliffe: The Great Gatsby) sets out to join the Resistance, against the robots, the fate of the world lies in his hands. Hot on his heels however, is robot collaborator Mr. Smythe (Ben Kingsley: Iron Man 3). This exhilarating British sci-fi thriller, delivers a bombastic robot takeover that is not to be missed!

programme.title: Extra Time
programme.desc: Former football star Troy is coaxed into rescuing the local footy team who have been told they will have to merge with a rival club or fold. Troy takes the controversial decision to team up with a nearby refugee support centre and take the community on a journey of change. But for some, it proves challenging. A hilarious and heart-felt comedy described as The Full Monty for the football pitch.

programme.title: White Mountain
programme.desc: This jaw-dropping climbing, Free Solo-esque documentary is a harrowing story of friendship, bravery and tragedy in one of the harshest environments known to man. 6 years after their trip to Dhaulagiri in the Himalayas to reach the peak of the almost mythical and rarely-climbed white wall, a group of Argentine climbers return to get closure on a fellow climber who was never to be seen again.

programme.title: Time Runners
programme.desc: Special Agent Sally Biggs has a secret, she can rewind time - whenever she wants. It's enough to make her a celebrity at the FBI and control almost everything in her life. But when her scientist husband disappears mysteriously, paranormal apparitions begin to surround her before she discovers the terrifying truth.

programme.title: The Beaver
programme.desc: Two-time Academy Award winner Jodie Foster directs and co-stars with two-time Academy Award winner Mel Gibson in The Beaver - an emotional story about a man on a journey to re-discover his family and re-start his life.

programme.title: Life of a King
programme.desc: Ex-felon, Eugene Brown, establishes a Chess Club for inner city teenagers in Washington, D.C.

programme.title: Life at These Speeds
programme.desc: After a teenager's friends are killed in an accident, he finds running allows him to remember them perfectly. Running, however, also brings him notoriety. Soon he finds himself caught between keeping the past alive and making new memories in the present.

programme.title: Noah
programme.desc: Academy Award® winner Russell Crowe stars as Noah, a man chosen by God for a great task before an apocalyptic flood destroys the world.

programme.title: The Engagement Dress
programme.desc: (2022) Romcom with Angel Prater. Wearing a lucky bridesmaid's dress has led to all her friends getting engaged. But when it doesn't work for Claudia, will it help her discover who's really 'the one'?

programme.title: When Love Springs
programme.desc: (2023) Lakeside romcom starring Rhiannon Fish and James O'Halloran. After running into an ex at her parents' vow renewal, Rory enlists a pretend plus one. But will faking it lead to real love?

programme.title: Love at the Lodge
programme.desc: (2022) Romance with Megan Elizabeth Barker. Lawyer Emma is promised a promotion if she can persuade Liam to sell his family's country lodge. But is she about to have a conflict of interest?

programme.title: Written in The Stars
programme.desc: (2021) Romance with Kimberley Crossman. A journalist teams up with an astrology guru to write about a local meteor shower festival - but will love also be written in the stars?

programme.title: Holly Star
programme.desc: (2018) Quirky festive fun with Katlyn Carlson. Could a near-death experience and a vision of buried treasure fix a cash-strapped puppeteer's problems? Anything's possible at Christmas...

programme.title: Between us
programme.desc: Henry and Dianne fear that settling down means giving up on their dreams. It will take the universe conspiring to keep them apart for them to realize just how much they need each other.

programme.title: And So It Goes
programme.desc: A self-absorbed realtor enlists the help of his neighbor when he's suddenly left in charge of the granddaughter he never knew existed until his estranged son drops her off at his home.

programme.title: First Daughter
programme.desc: Samantha Mackenzie wants what every college freshman desires: to experience life away from home and parents. It's not going to be easy, however, because home for Sam is the White House, and her dad is the President of the United States.

programme.title: A Week in Paradise
programme.desc: A film star with a newly broken heart jets off to paradise in the Caribbean, where she finds not only herself again, but maybe even a new love.

programme.title: At Sachem Farm
programme.desc: Ross plans to sell his family's wine collection to finance a mining interest, but standing in his way is Uncle Cullen, who has different plans for the family estate.

programme.title: You Can't Fight Christmas
programme.desc: Interior designer Leslie Major loves all things Christmas. When she meets handsome Edmund James, she quickly learns he thinks the festivities are frivolous and superficial.

programme.title: The Flight Before Christmas
programme.desc: Starring Mayim Bialik and Ryan McPartlin. Two strangers offer to share the last remaining room at a bed-and-breakfast when a snowstorm strands their flight in Montana on Christmas Eve.

programme.title: Autumn Stables
programme.desc: After her husband's death, Autumn sells her ranch to Jake expecting nothing will change, but Jake has ulterior motives with the land and her heart. Starring: Cindy Busby, Kevin McGarry, Alys Crocker

programme.title: Love, Alaska
programme.desc: When two childhood friends are reunited through a generous inheritance that bestows far more on their broken hearts than they bargained for - a second chance at love.

programme.title: After The Storm
programme.desc: Lauren wants to rebuild her community, including her family home, in the aftermath of a devastatingly disastrous storm.

programme.title: Beauty and the Billionaire: Bali
programme.desc: American doctor Ivy Miller lives in Bali, working at a charitable health clinic. When a billionaire benefactor named Dylan Donnelly arrives, Ivy is less than impressed. He is only interested in making himself look better by appearing charitable. Ivy is happy when he goes on his way, but then an accident injures one of Dylan's trusted advisors, Blake. Dylan insists Ivy stay at Dylan's lavish estate in Bali to care for Blake until he's well.

programme.title: Whisper Island
programme.desc: In pursuit of lost Civil War gold to save their fading ranch, two kids help an old woman solve the mystery of her past.

programme.title: Blueprint To The Heart
programme.desc: An interior designer trying to save her home renovation show needs to apply her successful, upscale "fixer upper" home renovation strategy to her blue collar carpenter by making the sweet but disheveled guy her next fixer upper project.

programme.title: Victoria Gotti: My Father's Daughter
programme.desc: Victoria Gotti produces, writes, and narrates life as a mob boss's daughter.

programme.title: Death of a Vegas Showgirl
programme.desc: Two incredibly talented dancers become involved in a tumultuous relationship.

programme.title: Lonnie/Rulon/Stanley
programme.desc: Lonnie plays dead for four agonizing hours.

programme.title: Obsession
programme.desc: 20-year-old Madison is forced to quickly find a new roommate.

programme.title: Obsession
programme.desc: When Blake Collins manages to escape a prison van in Detroit.

programme.title: The Baby Proposal
programme.desc: Sparks fly between a TV show host and her colleague when they become the unexpected guardians of a baby.

programme.title: His Secret Past
programme.desc: Popular crime novelist, Jennifer Becker lives a lavish life in a small coastal town in California with her daughter, Lily. One day, while out for a run, Lily is attacked--but then rescued by a mysterious stranger named Mick.

programme.title: Hit and Run
programme.desc: A lawyer is riding high after putting a receiving a Not Guilty verdict for her client, but has to look over her shoulder when a woman she meets in a traffic accident is not all she appears to be.

programme.title: Love is a Piece of Cake
programme.desc: A baker develops a budding romance with a client's brother while trying to save her cake shop from developers.

programme.title: Loverboy
programme.desc: When it comes to romance, Patrick Dempsey delivers in this madcap comedy. Working his way through college as a pizza delivery boy, Dempsey learns a few lessons in love from bored housewives who are looking for more than anchovies on their pizza.

programme.title: Funny Lady
programme.desc: FUNNY LADY resumes several years after FUNNY GIRL and chronicles Fanny Brice's relationship--both personal and professional--with second husband, showman Billy Rose.

programme.title: Spanglish
programme.desc: For John Clasky (Adam Sandler), life as a celebrity chef means balancing a high-profile career and raising a family. So when his family hires a gorgeous new housekeeper from Mexico, John quickly learns it may be his life that needs translation!

programme.title: How Do You Know?
programme.desc: Feeling a bit past her prime at 27, former athlete Lisa Jorgenson finds herself in the middle of a love triangle, as a corporate guy in crisis competes with Lisa's current, baseball-playing beau.

programme.title: Golden Years
programme.desc: When Arthur and Martha find that their pension pot is virtually worthless they decide to take drastic action by robbing a bank! After their first robbery is successful they start to like the criminal lifestyle, but as the robberies get riskier will they be able to outwit the police as they close in?

programme.title: India Sweets and Spices
programme.desc: When Alia returns home from university, she challenges her parents' elitist lifestyle expensive jewellery, lavish dinner parties, and gossiping aunties. But when she invites the son of a local shopkeeper to her mother's upcoming soiree, family secrets begin to surface.

programme.title: She's Funny That Way
programme.desc: Isabella, a young Hollywood starlet, recalls how the actions of charming Broadway director, Arnold, changed her life forever.

programme.title: Big Momma's House
programme.desc: FBI agent Malcolm Turner is known best for being a brilliant, master of disguise. Malcolm's latest assignment sends him to small-town Georgia, where he's assigned to trap a brutal bank robber who the FBI suspects will be coming down to visit his ex-girlfriend Sherry and her son.

programme.title: Bad Man's River
programme.desc: Robber Roy King loses his wife, Alicia, to revolutionary Montero. Despite their rivalry they collaborate in an attempt to rob the Mexican government of one million dollars.

programme.title: Wanted
programme.desc: A local sheriff is unjustly accused of murder in a small town and forced to flee.

programme.title: Shoot the Living and Pray for the Dead
programme.desc: After Dan Hogan and his gang rob a bank, they hire a mysterious man to guide them across the Mexican border in return for half of the loot.

programme.title: Halleluja and Sartana Strike Again
programme.desc: Two charming conmen—one posing as a missionary—set out to swindle a church group but end up clashing with a gang of greedy landgrabbers. In this slapstick western, the schemers unexpectedly turn into heroes as they help protect the townsfolk from losing everything.

programme.title: Out of the Clouds
programme.desc: Out of the Clouds follows the lives of passengers and crew during a typical bustling day at Heathrow Airport.

programme.title: Black Orchid
programme.desc: A man seeking divorce to marry his wife's sister faces scandal when she suddenly dies.

programme.title: Secret People
programme.desc: Two girls come from abroad to a small Paddington cafe, run by Anselmo, an ebullient South European.

programme.title: Behind the Mask
programme.desc: Sir Arthur Benson Gray, surgeon at Graftondale Hospital, appoints newly-qualified Philip Selwood as registrar

programme.title: A Challenge for Robin Hood
programme.desc: After being falsely accused of murder, Sir Robin of Loxley takes refuge in the wilderness of Sherwood Forest.

programme.title: The Light of Truth
programme.desc: Arabia 843 AD: A sheik uses the Light of Truth to reveal his general as a traitor. 2001: Prince Shareem drops out from Sydney's class to go search for the Light of Truth.

programme.title: Treasure Island
programme.desc: Sydney's on the hunt for a Pirate's booty, but will a traitor force her to walk the plank?

programme.title: Women Want to Know
programme.desc: Sydney has found a temple with an idol of Ganesha and it is being filmed for TV, but they get trapped inside when the local rebels stumble onto them. Can Nigel and Karen help from USA?

programme.title: The Star of Nadir
programme.desc: An anonymous Sultan's wife Danielle dies in mysterious circumstances in the desert. However, she had called for Sydney to help. Sydney believes Danielle was searching for the Star of Nadir.

programme.title: Devil Doll
programme.desc: A guide leads Sydney and Nigel to an unusual, underground Aztec burial chamber. Instead of a body, they find a relic.

programme.title: Incognito
programme.desc: Retrieving a mythical lancet, Sydney and Nigel run into Nigel's look-alike just before his death. Nigel gets a cut from the lancet. Later, Cate persuades Nigel to impersonate the man.

programme.title: All Choked Up
programme.desc: Carson Inez, a collector, uses an ancient necklace to get Sydney to help her in raising Athena who will then help her conquer the world.

programme.title: Warlock of Nu Theta Phi
programme.desc: When Sydney's student Meg's roommate finds a witch's amulet, it hospitalizes Meg. Meg's boyfriend's fraternity brother races to get the amulet. What is he up to?

programme.title: The Mortal Instruments: City of Bones
programme.desc: Clary Fray thinks she is just an ordinary teenager living in Brooklyn, but everything changes one night when in a downtown club she encounters the mysterious and charismatic Jace , and witnesses a shocking murder.

programme.title: Hot Pursuit
programme.desc: An uptight and by-the-book cop (Reese Witherspoon) tries to protect the sexy and outgoing widow (Sofia Vergara) of a drug boss as they race through Texas pursued by crooked cops and murderous gunmen.

programme.title: The Last Legion
programme.desc: As the Roman empire collapses, young Romulus Augustus must leave the city and set out for a dangerous journey to Britain to locate his last legion of supporters.

programme.title: Survivor
programme.desc: SURVIVOR is a gripping thriller about State Department employee Kate Abbott, newly posted in the American embassy in London. Kate is charged with stopping terrorists from getting into the U.S. which puts her directly in the line of fire.

programme.title: The Man From Toronto
programme.desc: The world's deadliest assassin and New York's biggest screw-up are mistaken for each other.

programme.title: Gloria (1980)
programme.desc: Rowlands garnered an Oscar nomination for her fierce portrayal as an ex-mob mistress who takes care of a young boy after his family is wiped out by the Mafia. Gloria must rely on all her street-savvy to prevent both herself and the boy from being the mobster's next target.

programme.title: Blue Streak
programme.desc: Miles Logan (Martin Lawrence) is a talented jewel thief who has stolen $20 million dollars worth of diamonds and has hidden them at a construction site before being captured. programme.title: Jack's Back [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In a sickening coincidence -- or a sinister homage to actual crimes -- women are being murdered in Los Angeles 100 years after Jack the Ripper terrorized London. Police think John Westford, a young doctor, is the murderer, and when he's found hanging from a noose, authorities believe his apparent suicide is a tacit admission of guilt. But his twin brother, Rick (also Spader), insists John was killed, and, when it appears Rick is right, the investigation takes a stunning turn.

programme.title: The Crush [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Writer Nick Eliot moves to a new city for a magazine job and rents a room in the house of Cliff and Liv Forrester, whose 14-year-old daughter, Adrian, instantly makes her attraction to Nick clear. While Nick romances photographer Amy Maddik at work, he has trouble fending off Adrian's advances. As her obsession with Nick grows, Adrian becomes angry at being rejected and starts attacking his property and friends.

programme.title: Gang of Roses
programme.desc: A gang of gold-hunting outlaws, headed by the ruthless Left Eye Watkins (Bobby Brown), takes over the peaceful town of Flatridge, tearing the sleepy outpost to shreds as they search for riches. They murder a can-can girl, who is the sister of Rachel (Monica Calhoun), the onetime leader of a notorious all-girl gang. Rachel then rounds up her four old associates, and they seek revenge for her sister. Using teamwork and a sassy attitude, Rachel's gang goes up against Watkins' tough crew.

programme.title: Fever Pitch [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A sports fan's romantic courtship clashes with his obsession with his favorite football team. Based on the book by Nick Hornby.

programme.title: Children of the Corn
programme.desc: As physician Burt Stanton (Peter Horton) and his girlfriend, Vicky (Linda Hamilton), drive across the Midwest to his new job, their trip comes to a sudden halt when they encounter the body of a murdered boy in the road. In trying to contact the authorities, Burt and Vicky wander into a small town populated only by children, followers of sinister young preacher Isaac Chroner (John Franklin). Soon the couple is fleeing the youthful fanatics, who want to sacrifice them to their demonic deity.

programme.title: Hard Boiled [English-Language Version] [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A tough-as-nails cop teams up with an undercover agent to shut down a sinister mobster and his crew.

programme.title: A Tale Of Two Guns
programme.desc: In the lawless West, The Cowboys a notorious brotherhood of killers and thieves reigned over the land with brutal fists and fast guns. Fate had finally caught up with them - and now the merciless gang has but a single surviving member. When a deputized gunslinger takes up the call to hunt down the last Cowboy, the chase is on and the bullets fly and only one of these hardened men can survive.

programme.title: Freejack [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Early in the 21st century, technological advances have made it possible for aging, wealthy people to pay crooks like Vacendak (Mick Jagger) to go back in time, kidnap young victims like race car driver Alex Furlong (Emilio Estevez) and deliver them to the elderly clients, who then have their brains transplanted into the healthy bodies. Furlong manages to break free from his captors, but as a fugitive, he finds that the world of the future is a bleak, dangerous place.

programme.title: Castle Falls [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: After decades of neglect, Castle Heights Hospital is packed with dynamite and ready to be demolished. However, no one knows that a gang leader, now in prison, hid $3 million in stolen cash inside the abandoned building. Now, three desperate parties want the money -- and they have exactly 90 minutes to find it and get out alive.

programme.title: Curious Caterer
programme.desc: Un jeune écrivain charmant et insouciant tombe amoureux de la femme de sa vie, mais il découvre qu'elle est déjà fiancée.

programme.title: Curious Caterer
programme.desc: Un marié retrouvé mort et une mariée disparue ramènent l'enquêteuse amateur Goldy Berry sur le chemin de l'enquêteur Tom Schultz.

programme.title: Curious Caterer
programme.desc: Goldy Berry fait équipe avec l'enquêteur Schultz pour résoudre un meurtre commis lors d'un festin médiéval.

programme.title: Curious Caterer
programme.desc: Une soirée tourne au vinaigre lorsque le chanteur de l'événement est électrocuté, transformant les lieux en scène de crime.

programme.title: La vengeance sucrée : une enquête de Hannah Swensen
programme.desc: Un meurtre commis dans un centre d'entraînement complique l'organisation du mariage de Hannah et Mike.

programme.title: The Trouble With Angels
programme.desc: A pair of troublemakers wreak havoc on a convent school.

programme.desc: A publicity stunt links a writer in matrimony with a chauvinistic medical school professor.

programme.title: How To Save A Marriage (And Ruin Your Life)

programme.title: Meteor
programme.desc: A collision between two massive rocks in outer space sends a large meteor hurtling toward Earth.

programme.title: Honest Thief
programme.desc: Hoping to cut a deal, a professional bank robber agrees to return all the money he stole in exchange for a reduced sentence. But when two FBI agents set him up for murder, he must now go on the run to clear his name and bring them to justice.

programme.title: Downfall
programme.desc: In 1942, young Traudl Junge (Alexandra Maria Lara) lands her dream job -- secretary to Adolf Hitler (Bruno Ganz) at the peak of his power. Three years later, Hitler's empire is now his underground bunker. The real-life Traudl narrates Hitler's final days as he rages against imagined betrayers and barks orders to phantom armies, while his mistress, Eva Braun (Juliane Köhler), clucks over his emotional distance, and other infamous Nazis prepare for the end.

programme.title: California Dreams

programme.title: Down in Shadowland
programme.desc: A five year project involving filming on NYC subway.

programme.desc: A prospector becomes a small town outcast after a man he rescues from a lynching double-crosses him.

programme.title: Legend Of The Golden Gun
programme.desc: A quiet young farmer turns into a deadly gunfighter who dedicates his life to the pursuit of evildoers.

programme.title: Charles Mingus, Jaki Byard, Dannie Richmond & Johnny Coles
programme.sub-title: Charles Mingus And Eric Dolphy live in Liège
programme.desc: Charles Mingus showcases an exceptional concert performed in April 1965 featuring his most celebrated lineup: Jaki Byard (piano), Dannie Richmond (drums), Johnny Coles (trumpet), Clifford Jordan (tenor sax) and the great Eric Dolphy (alto sax, flute and bass clarinet). Recorded within an eight-day span, less than three months before Dolphy's death, the three concerts showcase Mingus's visionary leadership and the band's incredible depth and diversity with unique performances and arrangements of classics including ‘So Long Eric' and the groundbreaking ‘Meditations On Integration'.

programme.title: Lianne La Havas
programme.desc: Lianne La Havas' performance at Casino de Paris captures the British singer-songwriter at her best: with her crystalline voice she performs soulful melodies full of sincerity. The performance is part of La Havas' 'Blood Tour', a concert tour promoting her second album 'Blood' (2015). She is accompanied by James Wyatt on keys, Adam Prendergast on bass, Giles King Ashong on drums, and Frida Touray on backing vocals.

programme.title: Maceo Parker
programme.desc: As a 25-year-old saxophonist, Maceo Parker played in the band of James Brown, but he is also known for his collaborations with George Clinton's Parliament-Funkadelic and Bootsy Collins' Rubber Band. Maceo has proven his star quality by creating a special chemistry between all the different styles of American black music. As a pioneer in the ‘groove', he blends funky jazz with roots and blues with gospel. The result? Overheated concert halls, with enthusiastic audiences that completely surrender themselves to the music's boundless energy.

programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Buster Williams
programme.sub-title: Ode to Miles: Bitches Brew Beyond
programme.desc: For the 40th anniversary of jazz legend Miles Davis' legendary album Bitches Brew, trumpeter Wallace Roney leads a band that revives the master's music. This project is the brainchild of Miles' family (including his son Erin), which is represented by his nephew, drummer Vince Wilburn. This concert at the ancient theater in Vienne, France, is a grand tribute to Miles.

programme.title: Bill Evans
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Sun Ra
programme.sub-title: Sun Ra Arkestra - Estival Jazz Lugano
programme.desc: Estival Jazz Lugano is an annual open-air music festival that takes place over five days at the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. On July 3, 1985, pianist and space-faring jazz icon Sun Ra and his Arkestra crash-landed at Estival Jazz Lugano. Featuring saxophonists Marshall Allen, John Gilmore and Danny Ray Thompson, clarinetist Eloe Omoe, flautist James Jackson, trombonist Tyrone Hill and a cavalcade of other costumed talents, Sun Ra puts on a truly out-of-this-world concert.

programme.title: Walter Trout, Johnny Griparic, Teddy Andreadis "Zig Zag" & Michael Leasure
programme.desc: Every year since 1970, the German city of Burghausen has been hosting one of the largest jazz festivals in the world. During Burghausen International Jazz Week, Burghausen becomes a 'Bavarian jazz mecca': guests from all over the world join the Burghausers to enjoy the most wonderful jazz performances as the colorful hustle and bustle of spectators and musicians shake up the city. One of the bands performing here in 2019 is the Walter Trout Band. Trout, who was born in New Jersey and is based in Los Angeles, is a world-famous contemporary blues rock guitarist and vocalist.

programme.title: Avishai Cohen
programme.desc: Double bassist Avishai Cohen's trio with Noam David (drums) and Omri Mor (pianist) joined forces with the international Symphony Orchestra ‘INSO-Lviv', conducted by Christian Schumann. On June 24, 2017 they brought Avishai Cohen's signature blend of influences from Eastern Europe, American jazz and the Middle East to the Alfa Jazz Festival in Lviv, Ukraine. Cohen, who also supplies vocalizations in the Judeo-Spanish dialect Ladino, came to prominence internationally in the 1990s when jazz great Chick Corea offered him a place in his trio and a recording deal. Thirty years later, Cohen has become a house-hold name himself, leaving his Ukrainian audience enthralled and connected through the universal language of music.

programme.title: Marcus Miller
programme.desc: This portrait of Marcus Miller was recorded during his 2009 ‘Tutu Revisited' tour. Miller looks back on his relationship with Miles Davis. Miller tells us about writing his composition 'Tutu', and shares countless stories of the recording process of the album 'Tutu'. This documentary was filmed in 2009 at the 'We Want Miles' exhibition in Cité de la Musique in Paris.

programme.title: Marta Gardolińska, Gareth Davies & London Symphony Orchestra
programme.sub-title: The LSO performs Boulanger, Dalbavie & Tchaikovsky
programme.desc: Polish conductor Marta Gardolińska conducts the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in a concert program consisting of Lili Boulanger's D'un Martin de Printemps, Marc-André Dalbavie's Concerto for Flute, and Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's Symphony No. 4 in F minor, Op. 36. The luminous optimism of the young Boulanger is poles apart from the raw passion and white-hot melodies of Tchaikovsky's semi-autobiographical symphony. LSO principal flute Gareth Davies brings out all the dazzle and daring of Dalbavie's 21st-century classic. The program closes with Prayer for Ukraine by composer Valentin Silvestrov. This concert was recorded at LSO St Luke's in London, UK, on May 18, 2022.

programme.title: Les Dissonances & David Grimal
programme.sub-title: Brahms - Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 73
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances present Johannes Brahms's Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 73. Whereas it took the composer over a decade to complete his first symphony, he penned his Symphony No. 2 in just a few months, during his summer sojourn in the restful Austrian village of Pörtschach in 1877. Nicknamed his ‘Pastoral' symphony, the work is arguably the most sunny and optimistic of Brahms's four symphonies. Lyrical in character, it features joyful melodies. This performance was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris, France, in 2015.

programme.title: Martha Argerich
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Martha Argerich, Iddo Bar-Shai, Maxim Vengerov & Mischa Maisky
programme.desc: In May and June 2021, Argentinian star pianist Martha Argerich celebrated her 80th birthday performing at Château de Chantilly, France. In this concert, recorded at the festival Les Coups de Cœur de Chantilly, Argerich is joined by three musicians who are particularly close to her heart: cellist Mischa Maisky, violinist Maxim Vengerov, and pianist Iddo Bar-Shaï. They perform with the orchestra Les Siècles under the baton of Romanian-Austrian conductor Ion Marin. The concert opens with Ludwig van Beethoven's Triple Concerto in C major, Op. 56, with Argerich, Vengerov, and Maisky as soloists. Written in 1803, it is Beethoven's only concerto for more than one solo instrument. This is followed by Camille Saint-Saëns's musical suite The Carnival of the Animals (Le carnaval des animaux), featuring Argerich and Bar-Shaï as the pianists. This musical suite from 1886 consists of 14 movements, each depicting a different animal. The work was published posthumously in 1922, as Saint-Saëns was concerned that his animal miniatures, full of delightful jokes, might damage his reputation as a serious composer. This performance was recorded at Château de Chantilly, on May 4, 2021.

programme.title: Leonardo García Alarcón, Cappella Mediterranea & Mariana Flores
programme.sub-title: Vocal baroque works by Cavalli, Strozzi & Bembo
programme.desc: Argentinian conductor and harpsichordist Leonardo García Alarcón leads his ensemble Cappella Mediterranea in a program of Italian Baroque music. The ensemble performs some of the finest Baroque pieces composed by Francesco Cavalli, a prominent composer in 17th-century Venice, and two of his famous students, Barbara Strozzi and Antonia Bembo. Argentinian soprano Mariana Flores presents the vocal works. On the program are ‘Mira questi due lumi' from Cavalli's Le nozze di Teti e di Peleo, ‘Dimmi, Amor, che farò' from L'Oristeo, ‘Sinfonia della notte' from L'Egisto, and ‘E vuol dunque Ciprigna' from Ercole Amante ‘M'ingannasti in verità' from Bembo's Produzioni armoniche consacrate a Luigi XIV Strozzi's Sino alla morte, Che si può fare, Lagrime mie, L'amante segreto, and è Pazzo il moi core Biagio Marini's La Romanesca Tarquinio Merula's Aria Sopra La Cieccona and Dario Castello's Sonata Seconda. This performance was recorded at the magnificent Église Notre-Dame of Sablé-sur-Sarthe, France, on August 26, 2020.

programme.title: Valery Gergiev
programme.desc: This visually stunning production of Nutcracker is a graceful and timeless adventure on a grand scale. From the lovely Waltz of the Flowers to the crystalline beauty of the stunning Snowflake Waltz, each scene is more breathtaking than the last, bringing to life all the well-known and beloved characters with fresh sparkle and compelling originality. It is Christmas Eve and we are brought to a party at which Drosselmeyer gives young Clara a nutcracker doll - beginning a night that includes a magically growing Christmas tree, a midnight battle of toy soldiers at which the Nutcracker defeats the villainous Mouse King and his army of mice, and a headlong pas de deux in which Clara and Hans-Peter meet and celebrate their triumph before being enveloped in a magical snowstorm. Act II whisks the young pair off to the Kingdom of the Sweets, where they are entertained by the Sugar Plum Fairy with her handsome Prince and her glittering court in a series of dazzling dances. Under the direction of Andreas Morell, Valery Gergiev conducts the Mariinsky Orchestra and Choir. Soloists are Mikhail Makarov, lldar Abdrazakov, Anna Markarova, Sergei Skorokhodov, Timur Abdikeyev, Vladislav Sulimasky. This production was recorded at the Mariinsky Theatre in 2012.

programme.title: David El Gnomo

programme.title: David El Gnomo
programme.desc: El príncipe Ben visita a David, quien lo ayudó de niño cuando no crecía como su hermano Tom.

programme.title: David El Gnomo
programme.desc: David y Lisa ayudan a un lobo cuya esposa fue envenenada y tiene tres cachorros que alimentar.

programme.title: La Vuelta Al Mundo De Willy Fog
programme.desc: En trineo a vela, Fog huye de Transfer. Tico enferma, pero se recupera y siguen rumbo a Nueva York.

programme.title: La Vuelta Al Mundo De Willy Fog
programme.desc: Pierden “El China” en Nueva York. Suben al “Henrietta” rumbo a Burdeos con el capitán Speedy.

programme.title: La Vuelta Al Mundo De Willy Fog
programme.desc: Fog quema todo el combustible del Henrietta. Compra el barco para seguir a toda máquina a Londres.

programme.title: Mi Mejor Regalo
programme.desc: Daniel descubre que tiene una hija de 8 años que quiere formar pae de su vida.

programme.title: La mujer mosquetero
programme.desc: Reinado de Luis XIV, 1660. La lealtad del pueblo francés está dividida entre la Iglesia y el Estado.

programme.title: El Coro
programme.desc: El director de uno de los mejores coros infantiles del mundo descubre un gran talento en un niño huérfano.

programme.title: Catástrofe Inminente
programme.desc: Cuando un asteroide saca a la Tierra de su órbita, un hombre descubre el plan para salvar a la humanidad.

programme.title: Close Up
programme.desc: La historia, el glamour, la cinematografía y los cotilleos de tus estrellas favoritas de Hollywood.

programme.title: El Pirata
programme.desc: La historia real de Ionnis Varvakis, un pirata griego que ganó una fortuna vendiendo caviar en Rusia.

programme.title: El Coro
programme.desc: El director de uno de los mejores coros infantiles del mundo descubre un gran talento en un niño huérfano.

programme.title: Los vecinos
programme.desc: Una pareja que espera su primer hijo descubre una rara diferencia con los vecinos que también va a ser padres.

programme.title: Nieve de verano
programme.desc: Hallie es una niña pequeña con un gran corazón, pero sus formas de ayudar a menudo crean un desastre.

programme.title: Presunto Secuestro
programme.desc: Después de sufrir tormentos y abusos a manos de su secuestrador, Elle es liberada repentinamente a un lado de la carretera sin explicación. Su novio Billy y su hermana Jen se apresuran a ayudarla después de que la encuentran, pero la reunión se ve frustrada por los detectives que comienzan a encontrar discrepancias en cada recuento de los eventos que llevaron a la captura de Elle.

programme.title: La Sospechosa
programme.desc: Beth ha sido acusada de matar a su marido. Todos creen que es culpable, hasta que aparece Jerry, un investigador de una aseguradora que le da el beneficio de la duda.

programme.title: Los McMasters
programme.desc: Finalizada la Guerra de Secesión, un hombre negro, vestido con el uniforme del ejército unionista, vuelve al rancho de su anterior amo, quien lo hace copropietario de sus tierras. Este hecho provoca la reacción de algunos vecinos racistas y fanáticos, cuyas ideas radicales acerca de la esclavitud y la diferencia de clases fundadas en el color de la piel, siguen muy arraigadas.

programme.title: Regreso a Bountiful
programme.desc: Años cuarenta. La anciana Carrie Watts (Geraldine Page) vive en un pequeño apartamento de Houston, con su hijo Ludie (John Heard) y su nuera Jessie Mae (Carlin Glynn). Hastiada de una vida marcada por las penurias y la tristeza, la señora Watts decide volver al pueblecito donde nació, se casó y cuidó a su hijos. Se trata de Bountiful, en Texas, muy cerca del Golfo de México. Un día, sin previo aviso, Carrie se escapa y emprende el viaje.

programme.title: La sala de baile
programme.desc: Ettore Scola recorre la historia de Europa de los últimos cincuenta años, más concretamente la de Francia, a través de la música y del baile. Lo que pretende es reflejar los cambios políticos y sociales, y las tendencias en la moda, desde 1936 hasta la actualidad. Toda la acción se desarrolla en un salón de baile y sin necesidad de diálogos.

programme.title: La hora del lobo
programme.desc: El artista Johan Borg y su mujer Alma viven un retiro en una pequeña isla. La mujer encuentra un cuaderno con unos siniestros dibujos, que representan las horribles pesadillas que sufre su marido. Cuando asisten a una fiesta de un barón vecino, descubren que los invitados se parecen a los demonios que Johan ve en sus pesadillas.

programme.title: Happy End
programme.desc: A nuestro alrededor, el mundo, y nosotros en medio, ciegos. Una instantánea de la vida de una familia burguesa europea.

programme.title: Prisioneros del sol
programme.desc: Una expedición multinacional descubre una ciudad perdida bajo una pirámide en la que tendrán que detener a los dioses del antiguo Egipto que han despertado para iniciar el apocalipsis.

programme.title: El dulce porvenir
programme.desc: Un autobús escolar se despeña montaña abajo y se hunde en un lago helado. En el accidente mueren todos los niños del pueblo. El abogado Mitchell Stevens se entrevista con los padres y les propone llevar el caso a los tribunales.

programme.title: El balneario de Battle Creek
programme.desc: El excéntrico doctor John Harvey Kellog es un defensor acérrimo de la vida natural y también regenta un lujoso balneario en Battle Creek, donde reúne a numerosos personajes de clase alta para poner en práctica sus peculiares normas dieteticas.

programme.title: Los Mercenarios
programme.desc: Un veterano de guerra ha reunido a un grupo de mercenarios de élite para operaciones puntuales de rescate.

programme.title: Los amos de Brooklyn
programme.desc: Tres policías coincidirán en una redada en la zona más peligrosa y criminalizada de Brooklyn.

programme.title: Mentiras e ilusiones
programme.desc: Un novelista del género policiaco y de espionaje es perseguido por un espía basándose en sus novelas.

programme.title: Conspiración Militar
programme.desc: Conspiraciones gubernamentales: ¿Qué ocurre cuando un soldado accede a los secretos detrás de las guerras?

programme.title: El Forastero (The Outsider)
programme.desc: Montana, finales del siglo XIX. El poderoso ganadero Fergus Hunter hace y deshace a su antojo en el condado. Decidido a comprar las tierras de unos colonos Amish pasará de la extorsión al asesinato.

programme.title: Trumbo: La lista negra de Hollywood.
programme.desc: La carrera del guionista Dalton Trumbo se interrumpe abruptamente a finales de la década de 1940 cuando lo incluyen junto a otras figuras de Hollywood en la lista negra por sus creencias políticas. Dirigida por Jay Roach, cuenta la historia de la guerra del guionista con el gobierno de los EE. UU.

programme.title: Azul y no tan rosa
programme.desc: Diego es un joven fotógrafo exitoso que vive en el glamoroso mundo de la moda, la superficialidad y el exceso. Un brutal ataque homófobo trastoca su vida cuando su pareja queda en coma. Justo en ese terrible momento, Diego, inesperadamente, debe cuidar de su hijo Armando...

programme.title: El Barón Rojo
programme.desc: Película biográfica que narra partes de la vida del mítico as de la aviación de la Primera Guerra Mundial Manfred von Richthofen, cuya habilidad y hazañas le llevó a convertirse en una leyenda durante esa contienda, temido por sus adversarios.

programme.title: Si no despierto
programme.desc: Fantasía juvenil seria y sincera sobre el destino, que tiene suficiente dimensión trágica para atraer a los jóvenes y a los amantes del entretenimiento con mensaje positivo. Una chica tiene la oportunidad de revivir 7 veces su último día de vida para desvelar el misterio que rodea su muerte.

programme.title: El velo pintado
programme.desc: Walter y Kitty son una pareja de ingleses que deciden casarse por motivos equivocados y se establecen en Shanghai. En esta exótica ciudad, ella se enamora de otro hombre.

programme.title: El duodécimo hombre
programme.desc: Eran 12 saboteadores. Los Nazis mataron a 11. Esta es la verdadera historia del que se escapó.

programme.title: Evelyn
programme.desc: Basada en una historia real, narra como en la Irlanda de los años cincuenta la pequeña Evelyn y sus dos hermanos son separados y enviados a distintos orfanatos católicos, cuando un tribunal decide que su padre es incapaz de cuidar de ellos.

programme.title: Amor Sin Tiempo
programme.desc: Megan parece tener la vida perfecta: una relación amorosa con un maravilloso esposo y dos adorables hijos.

programme.title: Navidad Vuelve A Casa
programme.desc: Con la ayuda de su amor de la infancia y de su hijo de seis años, Abbey redescubre su espíritu navideño

programme.title: La promesa
programme.desc: Romance prohibido en la Alemania prebélica.

programme.title: Cariño, cuánto te odio
programme.desc: Rivales laborales descubren el amor.

programme.title: El amor te encuentra en San Valentín
programme.desc: Kennedy hereda un rancho en un pequeño pueblo.

programme.title: Seducción a la carta
programme.desc: La magia y la risa son los ingredientes principales de esta historia de amor sobre una propietaria y chef de un restaurante y un jefe de departamento de una tienda que no parecen tener nada en común.

programme.title: Remember Me
programme.desc: Claude, un hombre viudo de unos setenta años, que vive solo y está desencantado con su única hija, se entera un día de que LILLIAN, la mujer que fue el el primer amor de su vida tiene Alzheimer y está ingresada en una residencia especializada.

programme.title: Mi segunda vez
programme.desc: La ganadora de un Oscar Catherine Zeta-Jones (“Chicago”) da vida a una mujer que, tras descubrir que su marido la engaña, se va a Nueva York y allí se enamora de un joven que le hará descubrir que las segundas oportunidades existen.

programme.title: Lío en Broadway
programme.desc: Durante los ensayos de un nuevo proyecto teatral se forma un triángulo amoroso entre una esposa, una ex-amante, y una de las actrices.

programme.title: Devuélveme mi suerte
programme.desc: Ashley (Lindsay Lohan) es muy afortunada, tiene muy buena suerte y siempre le ha salido todo bien. Pero un día, Ashley besa a Jake (Chris Pine), el joven con peor suerte de la ciudad, y sus papeles se intercambian...

programme.title: Byzantium
programme.desc: En la orilla de un pueblo costero desolado se encuentra el hotel Byzantium. Después de años de abandono, sus puertas están a punto de ser abiertas de nuevo por la depredadora y seductora Clara, que planea convertir el hotel en un burdel, y su joven e introvertida hija Eleanor. Dos misteriosas mujeres que esconden un oscuro secreto que se remonta 200 años atrás y que está a punto de llegar a un clímax mortal.

programme.title: El joven detective Dee. El poder del dragón marino
programme.desc: China, año 665 d.C. La dinastía Tang está siendo amenazada por el reino coreano de Buyeo. Por ello, se envían barcos de guerra como advertencia. Sin embargo, la flota queda reducida a cenizas antes de llegar a su destino, supuestamente por el ataque del Dragón del Mar. La emperatriz ordena resolver el misterio de la desaparición de la flota de forma inmediata. El joven Dee llega ese mismo día para ocupar un puesto en el Departamento de Justicia.

programme.title: Envidia sana
programme.desc: Léa, Marc, Karine y Francis son dos parejas de viejos amigos. Se reúnen con frecuencia y todo funciona porque cada uno ocupa su lugar.

programme.title: Howl (Aullido)
programme.desc: Joe es el revisor del último tren que sale de Londres durante una tormentosa noche. Súbitamente el vehículo frena de golpe y se detiene en lo más profundo del bosque. El conductor sale de la cabina para averiguar qué ha causado el incidente pero nunca vuelve. El pánico cunde entre los pasajeros cuando Joe encuentra al conductor horriblemente mutilado. Algo brutal y peligroso acecha en la oscuridad.

programme.title: Incidencias
programme.desc: Los pasajeros de un tren comienzan a enfrentarse en medio de la nada durante un clima peligroso.

programme.title: Concursante
programme.desc: Martín Circo Martín, acaba de convertirse en el ganador del mayor premio de la historia de la televisión.

programme.title: Oficina Zombie
programme.desc: Un empleado de una fábrica descubre que una bebida energética convierte a sus compañeros en zombis.

programme.title: Operación Concha
programme.desc: Un estafador atrae a un inversor contratando a un doble de una estrella de cine.

programme.title: Cambio de rumbo
programme.desc: Rupert tiene 24 horas para cambiar radicalmente su vida o perder a Alison, la mujer a la que ama.

programme.title: Adivina quién
programme.desc: Cuando Theresa trae a su prometido, Simon Green, a casa para el 25.º aniversario de boda de sus padres, se olvida de mencionar un pequeño detalle: es blanco. Decidido a romper el compromiso de su hija, Percy Jones demuestra que el padre no siempre sabe lo que hace.

programme.title: Una noche con mi exsuegro
programme.desc: Durante una escala en Los Ángeles, el Señor Gallo, un testarudo y siempre ocupado hombre de negocios, decide ir a darle una sorpresa a su hija Ginnie. Pero una vez llega a su casa, descubre que ella se ha marchado sin dar explicaciones.

programme.title: Hojas de Hierba
programme.desc: Las vidas de dos gemelos idénticos (interpretados por Edward Norton) dan un giro cuando el primero, un profesor de filosofía, es confundido por el segundo, un traficante de drogas al que varios clanes del narcotráfico quieren ver muerto.

programme.title: Siete días y una vida
programme.desc: El mundo perfecto de una bella reportera de televisión Seattle queda desmoronado por la predicción de su muerte en siete días.

programme.title: Jack Y Su Gemela
programme.desc: Jack Sadelstein (Adam Sandler) es un exitoso publicista de Los Angeles casado con una hermosa mujer (Katie Holmes) y con hijos, que odia un determinado acontecimiento anual: la visita de su hermana gemela, Jill (también Adam Sandler). A Jack le vuelve loco lo absorbente que es Jill y su personalidad pasiva-agresiva, que ponen patas arriba su vida. Las cosas se escapan todavía más de su control cuando Jill decide alargar su visita. ¡Parece que no se marchará nunca!

programme.title: Una Casa Patas Arriba
programme.desc: Una casa patas arriba es la continuación de la tronchante comedia familiar de 2005 de Revolution Studios, Are We There Yet?, y continúa donde terminó la primera. Ahora casado con Suzanne (Nia Long), Nick Persons (Ice Cube) se ha comprado una casa tranquila en las afueras para escapar de la locura de la gran ciudad, y para disfrutar de más espacio con su nueva mujer e hijos, Lindsey y Kevin (Aleisha Allen y Philip Daniel Bolden). Pero cuando su nueva casa requiere costosas reparaciones y él queda a merced de un excéntrico contratista (John C. McGinley), el sueño de Nick de vivir en una urbanización se convierte rápidamente en una desenfrenada pesadilla.

programme.title: ¿Cuándo Llegamos?
programme.desc: Nick , un joven operador está deseando conseguir pedirle una cita a una mujer atractiva, Suzanne, de la que está locamente enamorado. Después de esperar un largo tiempo parece que el momento más esperado para Nick está a punto de llegar. Suzanne se encuentra atrapada en Vancouver y necesita a alguien que pueda recoger a sus hijos y llevarles hasta ella, Nick se ofrece para ser esa persona sin dudarlo, pero lo que no sabe es que para ellos ningún hombre es lo suficientemente bueno para su madre. El viaje que Nick se imaginaba no tendrá nada que ver con el que les espera, ya que acabará siendo una pesadilla.

programme.title: Di Que Si
programme.desc: A una pareja poco probable la embaucan para que compita en un reality show de parejas con la única finalidad de sorprender a los productores del programa robando el corazón del público con su incompatibilidad total.

programme.title: Gunfight at Rio Bravo
programme.desc: Un misterioso pistolero ruso ayuda a un marshal y a un sheriff en un enfrentamiento con una sanguinaria banda de forajidos conocida como Los Sabuesos del Infierno, que han invadido su pequeño pueblo del este de Texas.

programme.title: Duelo de razas
programme.desc: Los esfuerzos comunes del gobierno estadounidense y de la nación comanche para negociar un tratado de paz son saboteados por los indios renegados y por el miope comisario indio.

programme.title: La batalla de los rancheros
programme.desc: Antigua película del Oeste protagonizada por Brian Donlevy: La batalla de los rancheros - Las disputas por la propiedad de un hombre muerto se convierten en una sangrienta guerra en el campo.

programme.title: La mujer del látigo
programme.desc: Salvaje Oeste - Para evitar la soga del ahorcado, un vaquero acepta casarse con una bella pero ardiente pelirroja.

programme.title: Senderos de violencia
programme.desc: Un deshonrado explorador indio y su compañero son contratados para escoltar una carreta de armas a través del territorio indio.

programme.title: 7 soles
programme.desc: La cruel tragedia que sufren muchos inmigrantes indocumentados en el desierto de Arizona todos los días.

programme.title: Noches sin lunas ni soles
programme.desc: El Cairo ha pasado tres años en prisión. Cuatro meses antes de cumplir su condena, se fuga. El sheriff Maidana intenta recapturarlo.

programme.title: Muerto por Carol
programme.desc: Carol se muda con su padre y abuelo al tranquilo pueblo de Zapote, donde experimenta la intensidad del primer amor junto a Rito. Entre descubrimientos, emociones y el despertar de nuevos sentimientos, su vida cambia para siempre en esta historia íntima y entrañable.

programme.title: Lizzie
programme.desc: Una niña rebelde es enviada a pasar La Navidad al rancho de caballos de su abuela. Entabla amistad con el poni de su abuela y está decidida a ayudar a salvar el rancho de la ejecución hipotecaria.

programme.title: Yo soy otro
programme.desc: José, un ingeniero de sistemas, descubre en su piel los signos de la "litomiasis", una misteriosa enfermedad aún no clasificada en la que el cuerpo está totalmente cubierto por una segunda piel de bacterias voraces.

programme.title: El regreso de Aladino
programme.desc: Después de liberar a Bagdad de las garras de su terrible visir, Aladin está aburrido en palacio. Todavía no ha decidido pedir matrimonio a la princesa. Pero un terrible dictador, Shah Zaman, se invita al Palacio y anuncia que ha venido a tomar la ciudad y casarse con la Princesa. Aladin no tiene más remedio que huir del Palacio. Intentará recuperar a su antiguo Genio y así, volver para liberar a la ciudad y salvar a su novia.

programme.title: Éternité
programme.desc: A finales del siglo XIX, Valentine, de 20 años, se casa con Jules. Cien años más tarde, su nieta recorre un puente en París para encontrarse con el hombre que ama. Durante el siglo que las separa, hombres y mujeres se conocen, se enamoran y cruzan sus destinos, creando un árbol genealógico y una fuerza vital que continuará para la eternidad…

programme.title: El pequeño Nicolás
programme.desc: Inclinados sobre un gran folio en blanco en algún lugar entre Montmartre y Saint-Germain-des-Prés, Jean-Jacques Sempé y René Goscinny dan vida a El pequeño Nicolás, un niño risueño y travieso. La suya es una infancia alegre, llena de juegos, diversión, bromas, aprendizaje, complicidad, peleas y castigos. Las aventuras de Nicolás le llevan al estudio de sus creadores, donde habla con ellos de forma distendida. Sempé y Goscinny le cuentan cómo se conocieron y se hicieron amigos, y también responden a preguntas sobre su carrera, su infancia y sus ambiciones.

programme.title: Fly
programme.desc: Bex, una joven convicta, se une a un programa de rehabilitación social en la cárcel para lidiar con el doloroso trauma de su crimen. La dura líder del grupo, Ava, intenta encauzar a estos jóvenes por medio de una pasión común: el baile.

programme.title: Todos están muertos
programme.desc: Viendo a Lupe encerrada en casa, en bata y zapatillas, nadie diría que en los 80 fue una estrella del rock. La agorafobia no le permite salir de casa, y su madre, Paquita, se ocupa de ella y de su nieto adolescente. Pero a Paquita se le acaba el tiempo y no quiere marcharse sin recuperar a su hija.

programme.title: El pomo azul
programme.desc: Soledad, que forma una pareja aparentemente consolidada con Juan, busca el piso más apropiado para su futuro en común.

programme.title: Cuando todo esté en orden
programme.desc: Una película honesta y sentida sobre las relaciones entre padres e hijos y la devastación que suponen las drogas.

programme.title: La final
